Callout.Name: Illegal Off-Roading
Callout.Message: Vehicles driving off the marked trails.
Callout.Advisory: Two vehicles, tracks through protected ground.

Script.Line: There are two of them and neither is on the trail.
They have been across the protected ground. You can see the tracks.
They are heading up the fire road. That is where it comes out.

Lines.Approach: Two of them cutting through protected ground. The tracks are fresh.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
